name: fibronectin 1
pathways: positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction

function.text: FN1 encodes fibronectin [Cleaved into: Anastellin; Ugl-Y1; Ugl-Y2; Ugl-Y3]. Annotated molecular activities include extracellular matrix structural constituent and collagen binding. It participates in positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction and cell adhesion.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to spondylometaphyseal dysplasia, 'corner fracture' type (autosomal dominant); glomerulopathy with fibronectin deposits 2 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Phosphaturic mesenchymal tumor, malignant. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

function.text: FN1 encodes fibronectin. Based in part on similarity, fibronectins are involved in cell adhesion, cell motility, opsonization, wound healing, and maintenance of cell shape. It participates in osteoblast compaction through the fibronectin fibrillogenesis cell-mediated matrix assembly process, essential for osteoblast mineralization.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with spondylometaphyseal dysplasia, 'corner fracture' type (autosomal dominant); glomerulopathy with fibronectin deposits 2 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving FN1 have been reported in phosphaturic mesenchymal tumor, malignant.
